_comment: Vanilla-baseline settings template. Applied by scripts/install/vanilla_baseline.py --activate. Strips every faerie-specific hook, skill reference, and env var. Keeps only the minimum Claude Code needs: standard permissions + team-dispatch flag (which is a Claude Code native feature, not a faerie invention) + model choice. User's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the live settings.json is preserved automatically by the activate step; no need to reference it here.
